title: China’s Growing Grip On Printed Circuit Boards
text:
China’s Growing Grip On Printed Circuit Boards

Laila Khawaja

Gavekal Technologies: Chips | 15 Oct 2026

China accounts for nearly 60% of the global production value of printed circuit boards, foundational components in numerous defense and civil applications. AI is driving the demand for advanced PCBs and tightening the supply of various critical upstream materials. Chinese PCB makers are investing unprecedented amounts to expand advanced capacity, while upstream suppliers allocate scarce supplies towards higher-value AI products, both of which squeeze conventional PCB manufacturers. These trends could accelerate industry consolidation and strengthen China’s leading players, at a time when foreign governments are seeking to reduce dependence on Chinese PCBs.
